title: Vanredna linija 8L Trg kralja Aleksandra - Novo Groblje za Zadušnice

sections.text: Zbog održavanja verskog praznika „Zadušnice“ i povećanih zahteva za prevozom ka Novom Groblju, u petak 29.5.2026.godine, na delu trase redovne linije 8 Gabrovačka reka-Novo Groblje, uvodi se vanredna linija 8L Trg kralja Aleksandra - Novo Groblje na kojoj će u periodu od 09:00 do 15:00 časova saobraćati 2 vozila.

text_translations.en: Due to the observance of the "Remembrance Day" religious holiday and increased demands for transport to Novo Groblje, on Friday 29/5/2026, on part of the route of the regular line 8 Gabrovačka reka-Novo Groblje, an extraordinary line 8L Trg kralja Aleksandra - Novo Groblje will be introduced, on which 2 vehicles will operate between 09:00 and 15:00.

sections.text: Prevoz na redovnoj liniji broj 8 Novo Groblje - Gabrovačka reka obavljaće se po redu vožnje za radni dan.

text_translations.en: Transportation on the regular line number 8 Novo Groblje - Gabrovačka reka will be carried out according to the working day schedule.

sections.text: Red vožnje za petak 29.5.2026. godine za vanrednu liniju 8L možete pogledati ovde.

text_translations.en: Timetable for Friday 29.5.2026. year for the extraordinary line 8L can be viewed here.

sections.text: U subotu 30.5.2026. godine uvodi se vanredna linija 8L Trg Kralja Aleksandra - Novo Groblje na kojoj će u periodu od 07:00 do 15:00 časova saobraćati 4 vozila.

text_translations.en: On Saturday 30.5.2026., the extraordinary line 8L Trg Kralja Aleksandra - Novo Groblje was introduced, on which 4 vehicles will operate between 07:00 and 15:00.

sections.text: Prevoz na redovnoj liniji broj 8 Novo Groblje - Gabrovačka reka obavljaće se po subotnjem redu vožnje.

text_translations.en: Transportation on regular line number 8 Novo Groblje - Gabrovačka reka will be carried out according to the Saturday timetable.

sections.text: Red vožnje za subotu 30.5.2026. godine za vanrednu liniju 8L možete pogledati ovde .

text_translations.en: Timetable for Saturday 30.5.2026. year for the extraordinary line 8L can be viewed here.

sections.text: Ovim putem želimo da uputimo apel svim sugrađanima da za potrebe prevoza do Novog Groblja koriste vozila javnog prevoza kako bi se izbeglo stvaranje gužvi u saobraćaju.

text_translations.en: In this way, we would like to appeal to all fellow citizens to use public transport vehicles for transportation to Novi Groblje in order to avoid traffic jams.

title_translations.en: Emergency line 8L Trg kralja Aleksandra - Novo Groblje for Remembrance

sections.text: Tokom nastupajućih prvomajskih praznika u primeni je sledeći režim rada na svim linijama u javnom gradskom i prigradskom prevozu putnika na teritoriji Grada Niša:

text_translations.en: During the upcoming May Day holidays, the following operating regime is in effect on all lines of public urban and suburban passenger transport in the territory of the City of Niš:

sections.text: Od ponedeljka 04.05.2026.godine-u primeni je zimski red vožnje za radni dan

text_translations.en: As of Monday, May 4, 2026, the winter schedule for working days is in effect

title: Izmena režima javnog prevoza na trasi linija za Gornju Studenu od 29.4.2026.godine

sections.text: Za vreme izvođenja pripremnih  radova za asfaltiranje deonice puta u Jelašnici  od srede 29.04.2026.godine vrši se reorganizacija prigradskih linija u navedenom periodu, radnim danom i subotom (subotom uz prethodnu  najavu radova) od 07:30 do 16:30 časova uz uvođenje dve lokalne linije sa presedanjem.

text_translations.en: During the preparatory works for the asphalting of the road section in Jelašnica from Wednesday, April 29, 2026, the suburban lines will be reorganized in the specified period, on weekdays and Saturdays (on Saturdays with prior notice of the works) from 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. with the introduction of two local lines with transfers.

sections.text: Prva lokalna linija saobraća redovnom trasom od Prigradske autobuske stanice Niš do zone potpune obustave saobraćaja - stajališta  Jelašnica-OŠ „Đura Jakšić“ gde se vrši okretanje autobusa.

text_translations.en: The first local line operates on a regular route from the Suburban Bus Station Niš to the zone of complete suspension of traffic - the Jelašnica-OŠ "Đura Jakšić" stop, where the bus is turned around.

sections.text: Druga lokalna linija saobraća na delu od Gornje Studene do zone radova u Jelašnici.

text_translations.en: Another local line operates on the part from Gornja Studena to the work zone in Jelašnica.

sections.text: Zonu izvođenja radova putnici prelaze pešačenjem.

text_translations.en: Passengers cross the construction zone on foot.

sections.text: Za sve ostale informacije možete se obratiti informativnom centru JKP Direkcije za javni prevoz grada Niša na telefone 018/505-656, 018/505-665 ili putem veb sajta http://jgpnis.rs/

text_translations.en: For all other information, you can contact the information center of the PUC Directorate for Public Transport of the City of Niš at 018/505-656, 018/505-665 or via the website http://jgpnis.rs/

title_translations.en: Change of the public transport regime on the line route for Gornja Studena from April 29, 2026

title: Autobusko stajalište „Dom Vojske“ vraćeno na redovnu lokaciju

sections.text: Nakon završetka građevinskih radova na rekonstrukciji trotoara u Voždovoj ulici autobusko stajalište „Dom Vojske“ vraćeno je na redovnu lokaciju.

text_translations.en: After the completion of construction works on the reconstruction of the sidewalk in Voždova Street, the "Dom Vojske" bus stop was returned to its regular location.

title_translations.en: "Dom Vojske" bus stop returned to its regular location

title: Anketa korisnika sistema JGPP u Nišu

sections.text: Poštovani putnici,

text_translations.en: Dear passengers,

sections.text: U cilju analize postojećeg stanja i identifikacije problema u funkcionisanju sistema javnog gradskog i prigradskog prevoza putnika na teritoriji Grada Niša, sprovodi se istraživanje čiji je cilj prikupljanje stavova i iskustva korisnika prevoza usluge.

text_translations.en: In order to analyze the current situation and identify problems in the functioning of the system of public urban and suburban passenger transportation in the territory of the City of Nis, a survey is being conducted, the aim of which is to collect the views and experiences of the users of the transportation service.

sections.text: Pozivamo vas da svojim učešćem doprinesete realizaciji istraživanja popunjavanjem anketnog upitnika.

text_translations.en: We invite you to contribute to the realization of the research with your participation by filling out the survey questionnaire.

sections.text: Anketa je u potpunosti anonimna, a svi prikupljeni podaci koristiće se isključivo u istraživačke svrhe i za analizu kvaliteta usluga javnog gradskog prevoza na teritoriji Grada Niša.

text_translations.en: The survey is completely anonymous, and all collected data will be used exclusively for research purposes and for the analysis of the quality of public transport services in the territory of the City of Niš.

sections.text: Za popunjavanje upitnika potrebno je oko 5 minuta. Upitnik se popunjava preko sledećeg linka ovde.

text_translations.en: It takes about 5 minutes to fill out the questionnaire. The questionnaire is filled out via the following link here.

sections.text: Hvala vam na izdvojenom vremenu i saradnji.

text_translations.en: Thank you for your time and cooperation.

title_translations.en: Survey of users of the JGPP system in Nis

sections.text: Na gradskoj liniji broj 4 Čalije-Bubanj i prigradskim linijama broj 15 Niš-Knez selo i 15L Niš-Gornji Matejevac u ulici Bulevar Medijana (Matejevački put) formiraju se dva nova stajališta od ponedeljka 16.3.2026.godine.

text_translations.en: On city line number 4 Čalije-Bubanj and suburban lines number 15 Niš-Knez selo and 15L Niš-Gornji Matejevac in Bulevar Medijana street (Matejevacki put), two new stops will be formed from Monday, March 16, 2026.

sections.text: Iz smera od Knjaževačke ulice ka kružnoj raskrsnici sa Bulevarom Sv. Pantelejmona novo stajalište Matejevački put 1 (od centra) na linijama 15 i 15L, nalazi se neposredno pre kružne raskrsnice u smeru ka Knez selu.

text_translations.en: From the direction of Knjaževačka street towards the roundabout with Bulevar Sv. Panteleimon new stop Matejevački put 1 (from the center) on lines 15 and 15L, is located immediately before the roundabout in the direction of Knez village.

sections.text: Iz smera od kružne raskrsnice na Bulevaru Sv.Pantelejmona ka Knjaževačkoj ulici, novo stajalište Matejevački put 1 (ka centru) na linijama 4, 15 i 15L, nalazi se nakon kružne raskrsnice (ka Knjaževačkoj ulici).

text_translations.en: From the direction of the roundabout on St. Pantelejmon Boulevard towards Knjaževačka Street, the new stop Matejevački put 1 (towards the center) on lines 4, 15 and 15L is located after the roundabout (towards Knjaževačka Street).
